description: The fixes: (2) browser-like default request headers on every fetch, (3) a 3-attempt YouTube policy with 2 s / 8 s backoff and the probe-chosen Accept/cookie/URL variant, (4) the arxiv-cs.AI fix: the RSS is a valid empty feed before arXiv's ~04:00 UTC rebuild and the export.arxiv.org API fallback timed out at the default 20 s with no room for its retry inside the 45 s per-source backstop; give the fallback a 15 s timeout so the existing single retry fits, and put the fallback error class into the note. Plan items 5-8 and decisions D2, D3, D4 in .agents/tasks/ahead-build/runner-fix-plan.md. Depends on FEAT-001 (reads its findings for D3's conditional rules; relies on `detail`). Locally only the unit tests and 'nothing breaks' can be checked; whether the Cloudflare 403s and YouTube 404s clear is RUNNER-ONLY.
steps: Read context.json, runner-fix-plan.md (items 5-8, D2-D4) and FEAT-001.json `findings` FIRST. From the findings decide, before editing: (i) YouTube Accept: the variant among (b) browser+feed Accept, (c) browser+'*/*', (d) c+cookie with the most 200s across the six channels on the runner; tie or all zero -> '*/*' with no cookie. (ii) Cookie header for www.youtube.com only if a YouTube `location` header pointed at consent.youtube.com. (iii) Switch sources.config.mjs yt() to `https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?playlist_id=UU${channelId.slice(2)}` only if the playlist form got 200s on at least two channels where channel_id got zero. Write the three decisions into this file's findings as you start. git pull --rebase origin main.

src/http.js headers (D2): export BROWSER_USER_AGENT = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' and IDENTIFIED_HOSTS = new Set(['www.reddit.com', 'api.github.com']); set ACCEPT.feed = 'application/rss+xml, application/atom+xml, application/xml;q=0.9, text/html;q=0.8, */*;q=0.7' (ACCEPT.json and ACCEPT.html unchanged). headersFor(url, accept): host = new URL(url).hostname; headers = { 'user-agent': IDENTIFIED_HOSTS.has(host) ? userAgent : BROWSER_USER_AGENT, accept: accept ?? ACCEPT.feed, 'accept-language': 'en-US,en;q=0.9' }; for host 'www.youtube.com' override accept with the variant from step 1 (default '*/*') and add the cookie only under rule (ii); keep the api.github.com token + 'application/vnd.github+json' override exactly as is. Keep DEFAULT_USER_AGENT and the userAgent option (they now feed only the identified hosts). Redirect following is unchanged.

src/http.js retries (D3): replace the single-retry block in fetchText with a plan: retryPlan(host) returns [2000, 8000] for 'www.youtube.com' and [2000] otherwise; retryable(err, host) for 'www.youtube.com' returns true for HttpError 404, >= 500, 429 and for timeouts/network errors (BodyTooLarge still false; www.reddit.com still never retries). Loop over the plan: wait = backoff (429 with retry-after -> min(retryAfter, 30_000) as today), await sleep(wait), then `if (deadlineAt !== undefined && deadlineAt - nowMs() < RETRY_MIN_REMAINING_MS) throw err;`, then attempt again via paced(host, () => once(url, opts)). Before throwing the final error set err.attempts = <number of attempts made> (1 when no retry ran). Keep the existing behaviour for every other host: exactly one retry on 5xx/429/network/timeout, none on other 4xx.

src/parsers/arxiv.js (D4): fetchApi calls ctx.fetchText(source.fallbackUrl, { timeoutMs: 15_000 }) (runSource's fetchText wrapper spreads opts after its defaults, so timeoutMs passes through). In fetchArxivSource change the empty-RSS + fallback-failed branch to note: `api fallback failed (${fb})` (e.g. 'api fallback failed (timeout)'). Everything else unchanged; status stays 'empty' there.

tests/helpers.js line 124 and tests/pipeline.test.js line 145: identify sitemap page fetches with `accept.startsWith('text/html')` instead of /text\/html/.test(accept) (the new ACCEPT.feed contains 'text/html;q=0.8' and would otherwise be routed to the generated page HTML).

tests/http.test.js: (a) rewrite 'user-agent and accept headers...' to assert headers['user-agent'] === BROWSER_USER_AGENT for https://mistral.ai/news/rss, headers.accept === ACCEPT.feed (exact string), headers['accept-language'] === 'en-US,en;q=0.9'; add assertions that https://www.reddit.com/r/x.rss and https://api.github.com/x get the Ahead UA (/^Ahead\//) and that https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=UCx gets the chosen YouTube accept (and cookie only if rule ii applied). (b) Update the retry-matrix test: YouTube [404, 404, ok('yt')] -> 3 calls at fake-clock times 0, 2000, 10000 and text 'yt'; YouTube [404, 404, 404] -> HttpError with err.attempts === 3 and errorClass 'HTTP 404'; YouTube [500, ok] -> 2 calls; non-YouTube 503 -> still exactly 2 calls; 403 -> 1 call; reddit 429 -> 1 call; the 25,000 / 24,999 ms deadline cases unchanged. (c) Add 'a 15 s timeout inside a 45 s deadline gets its retry': never-resolving fetchImpl (reuse the abort-listening one from the 42 s test), client.fetchText(url, { timeoutMs: 15_000, deadlineAt: 45_000 }) -> TimeoutError, exactly 2 fetch calls, clock.nowMs() <= 32_500; and with the default timeout under the same deadline exactly 1 call (documents why D4 picks 15 s).

tests/arxiv.test.js: make ctxWith's fetchText record (url, opts) into calls; assert in the 'valid empty RSS invokes the API fallback' test that the fallback call has opts.timeoutMs === 15000 and the primary call has no timeoutMs; change the 'valid empty RSS + fallback failure' expectation to note === 'api fallback failed (network)'. Other arXiv tests unchanged.

Local verification: npm test (0 fail); node scripts/fetch.mjs --dry-run --no-llm (exit 0; reddit and gh-* must still be ok, proving the identified-host exception; yt-* mostly ok; if the time is before ~04:00 UTC arxiv-cs.AI shows note 'api fallback'). Commit by name: git add src/http.js src/parsers/arxiv.js tests/http.test.js tests/arxiv.test.js tests/helpers.js tests/pipeline.test.js (plus sources.config.mjs only if rule iii applied) && git commit -m "fix(http): browser-like headers, 3-attempt YouTube policy, 15 s arXiv fallback timeout".

RUNNER round-trip: git pull --rebase origin main; git push origin HEAD:main; gh run watch <push run id> --exit-status; git pull --rebase origin main; read data/meta.json. Expected: arxiv-cs.AI ok (RSS or note 'api fallback') or at worst empty with note 'api fallback failed (<class>)'; reddit and gh-rel-*/gh-trending-* unchanged ok/empty. Record which of the 12 baseline failures are now ok/empty and which still fail with their `detail`. If all six yt-* still fail, dispatch exactly one more run with `gh workflow run refresh.yml -f probe=true` and record the per-variant 200 counts under the new client; do not iterate further (FEAT-003 handles what stays blocked).

Record in findings: the three D3 decisions taken and why, run ids, the per-source after-table for the 12 baseline sources + arxiv-cs.AI, and the exact list of sources still failing from the runner (FEAT-003 needs it for the README). Set status completed.
acceptance_criteria: npm test passes with 0 failures; the header test proves Chrome UA + Accept-Language + exact ACCEPT.feed on an ordinary host, the Ahead UA on www.reddit.com and api.github.com, and the chosen YouTube accept.
The retry test proves YouTube gets 3 attempts at 0 / 2000 / 10000 ms and err.attempts === 3 when all fail, while other hosts keep exactly one retry and 4xx (non-YouTube) is never retried.
The arXiv tests prove the fallback request carries timeoutMs 15000 and the failure note is 'api fallback failed (<class>)'; the http test proves two 15 s attempts fit a 45 s deadline.
The Actions run after the push succeeds; data/meta.json shows arxiv-cs.AI not failing, reddit/gh-* unchanged, and findings records per-source outcomes for the 12 baseline failures.
No proxy, mirror, scraper or API key was introduced; sources.config.mjs changed only under rule (iii).
verification: node scripts/fetch.mjs --dry-run --no-llm   (exit 0; reddit ok, gh-trending-* ok/empty, yt-* mostly ok)

findings:
D3 decisions taken before editing (from FEAT-001 findings, runner probe run 39369807517): (i) YouTube Accept variant: (b) browser+feed Accept 0/18, (c) browser+'*/*' 0/18, (d) c+cookie 0/18 -> all tie at zero -> Accept '*/*' for www.youtube.com, no cookie (the tie rule). (ii) Cookie header: NO. The probe saw zero YouTube responses with a location header pointing at consent.youtube.com (the only location header anywhere was the bare-host 301 to www.youtube.com), so rule (ii) is not met. (iii) Switch sources.config.mjs yt() to playlist_id=UU...: NO. The UU form got 0/18 on the runner and never succeeded on any channel where channel_id got zero, so rule (iii) is not met; sources.config.mjs is untouched.

CODE (commit 5c86db7 on main, 6 files, 124+/38-): src/http.js exports BROWSER_USER_AGENT (Chrome 155) and IDENTIFIED_HOSTS {www.reddit.com, api.github.com}; ACCEPT.feed = 'application/rss+xml, application/atom+xml, application/xml;q=0.9, text/html;q=0.8, */*;q=0.7'; headersFor() sends the browser UA + accept-language en-US,en;q=0.9 everywhere, the Ahead UA on the two identified hosts, accept '*/*' on www.youtube.com (no cookie), GitHub token/vnd.github+json override unchanged. fetchText() loops over retryPlan(host) = [2000, 8000] for www.youtube.com and [2000] otherwise, keeps the 429 retry-after cap (30 s) and the deadline skip (< 25 s remaining) per attempt, and sets err.attempts on the error finally thrown. src/parsers/arxiv.js fetchApi passes { timeoutMs: 15_000 }; the empty-RSS + fallback-failed note is now `api fallback failed (<class>)`. tests/helpers.js + tests/pipeline.test.js detect sitemap page fetches with accept.startsWith('text/html'). tests/http.test.js: header test rewritten (browser UA/Accept/Accept-Language on mistral.ai, Ahead UA on reddit + api.github.com, '*/*' and no cookie on YouTube), retry matrix extended (YouTube [404,404,ok] -> calls at 0/2000/10000; [404,404,404] -> attempts 3; [500,ok] -> 2 calls; non-YouTube [503,503,503] -> 2 calls, attempts 2; 403 -> 1; reddit 429 -> 1; deadline 25,000/24,999 unchanged), new '15 s timeout inside a 45 s deadline' test (2 attempts, done by 32,000 ms; default 20 s timeout -> 1 attempt). tests/arxiv.test.js: ctxWith records opts; fallback call has timeoutMs 15000, primary has none; failure note 'api fallback failed (network)'. No proxy, mirror, scraper or key; sources.config.mjs untouched.
